### Quickstart with Peekaboo CLI

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/skills/peekaboo/SKILL.md

Basic commands to get started with Peekaboo, including checking permissions, listing applications, taking a screenshot, clicking an element, and typing text.

```bash
peekaboo permissions
peekaboo list apps --json
peekaboo see --annotate --path /tmp/peekaboo-see.png
peekaboo click --on B1
peekaboo type "Hello" --return
```

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/platforms/windows.md

Inspect the latest setup log file to diagnose local installation and setup failures.

```powershell
notepad "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\OpenClawTray\Logs\Setup\easy-setup-latest.txt"
```

### Configure turn start parameters in JSON

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/test/fixtures/agents/prompt-snapshots/codex-runtime-happy-path/telegram-direct-codex-message-tool.md

Defines agent runtime execution settings, sender context, collaboration instructions, and sandbox policies for a turn start. Use as the configuration payload when initiating a direct Codex session.

```json
{
  "additionalContext": {
    "openclaw_current_sender": {
      "kind": "untrusted",
      "value": "{\"sender\":{\"id\":\"1000001\",\"name\":\"Pash\",\"username\":\"pash\"}}"
    }
  },
  "approvalPolicy": "never",
  "approvalsReviewer": "user",
  "collaborationMode": {
    "mode": "default",
    "settings": {
      "developer_instructions": "# Collaboration Mode: Default\n\nYou are now in Default mode. Any previous instructions for other modes (e.g. Plan mode) are no longer active.\n\nYour active mode changes only when new developer instructions with a different `<collaboration_mode>...</collaboration_mode>` change it; user requests or tool descriptions do not change mode by themselves. Known mode names are Default and Plan.\n\n## request_user_input availability\n\nUse the `request_user_input` tool only when it is listed in the available tools for this turn.\n\nIn Default mode, strongly prefer making reasonable assumptions and executing the user's request rather than stopping to ask questions. If you absolutely must ask a question because the answer cannot be discovered from local context and a reasonable assumption would be risky, ask the user directly with a concise plain-text question. Never write a multiple choice question as a textual assistant message.\n\n## OpenClaw Agent Soul\n\nOpenClaw loaded these workspace instruction files from the active agent workspace. They are the canonical definitions of who you are, how you think and work, and the human you work alongside. Internalize and follow them accordingly.\n\n### /tmp/openclaw-happy-path/workspace/IDENTITY.md\n\n<IDENTITY.md contents will be here>\n\n### /tmp/openclaw-happy-path/workspace/SOUL.md\n\n<SOUL.md contents will be here>\n\n### /tmp/openclaw-happy-path/workspace/USER.md\n\n<USER.md contents will be here>",
      "model": "gpt-5.5",
      "reasoning_effort": "medium"
    }
  },
  "cwd": "/tmp/openclaw-happy-path/workspace",
  "effort": "medium",
  "input": [
    {
      "text": "<see Reconstructed Model-Bound Prompt Layers>",
      "text_elements": [],
      "type": "text"
    }
  ],
  "model": "gpt-5.5",
  "personality": "none",
  "sandboxPolicy": {
    "type": "dangerFullAccess"
  },
  "threadId": "thread-telegram-direct-codex-message-tool"
}
```

### Start Development Gateway in Watch Mode

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/start/setup.md

Installs dependencies, completes initial configuration setup, and runs the Gateway inside a tmux watch session with hot reload.

```bash

# First run only (or after resetting local OpenClaw config/workspace)
pnpm openclaw setup
pnpm gateway:watch
```

### Define Thread Start Parameters

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/test/fixtures/agents/prompt-snapshots/codex-runtime-happy-path/telegram-direct-codex-message-tool.md

Specifies execution environment, feature flags, direct tool namespaces, and dynamic tools when initiating a new thread.

```json
{
  "approvalPolicy": "never",
  "approvalsReviewer": "user",
  "config": {
    "code_mode.direct_only_tool_namespaces": ["openclaw_direct"],
    "features.apply_patch_streaming_events": true,
    "features.code_mode": true,
    "features.code_mode_only": false,
    "features.goals": false,
    "features.standalone_web_search": false,
    "project_doc_max_bytes": 131072,
    "suppress_unstable_features_warning": true,
    "tools.update_plan.enabled": false,
    "web_search": "cached"
  },
  "cwd": "/tmp/openclaw-happy-path/workspace",
  "developerInstructions": "<see Reconstructed Model-Bound Prompt Layers>",
  "dynamicTools": [
    "agents_list",
    "message",
    "sessions_spawn",
    "automations",
    "gateway",
    "nodes",
    "session_status",
    "sessions_history",
    "sessions_list",
    "sessions_search",
    "sessions_send",
    "subagents",
    "tts",
    "web_fetch",
    "web_search",
    "sessions_yield"
  ],
  "experimentalRawEvents": true,
  "model": "gpt-5.5",
  "personality": "none",
  "sandbox": "danger-full-access",
  "serviceName": "OpenClaw"
}
```

### Example Project Environment File

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/scripts/clawdock/README.md

Shows a typical `<project>/.env` file, configuring Docker infrastructure settings like image name, ports, and gateway token.

```bash
OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR=/Users/you/.openclaw
OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR=/Users/you/.openclaw/workspace
OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT=18789
OPENCLAW_BRIDGE_PORT=18790
OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_BIND=lan
OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN=<generated-by-docker-setup>
OPENCLAW_AUTH_PROFILE_SECRET_DIR=/Users/you/.openclaw-auth-profile-secrets
OPENCLAW_IMAGE=openclaw:local
```

### Detailed examples for adding todos

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/skills/things-mac/SKILL.md

Examples demonstrating how to add todos with specific details like notes, project/area, heading, tags, checklist items, and multi-line input from STDIN.

```bash
things add "Buy milk"
```

```bash
things add "Buy milk" --notes "2% + bananas"
```

```bash
things add "Book flights" --list "Travel"
```

```bash
things add "Pack charger" --list "Travel" --heading "Before"
```

```bash
things add "Call dentist" --tags "health,phone"
```

```bash
things add "Trip prep" --checklist-item "Passport" --checklist-item "Tickets"
```

```bash
cat <<'EOF' | things add -
Title line
Notes line 1
Notes line 2
EOF
```

### Run non-interactive onboarding for vLLM via CLI

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/providers/vllm.md

Performs headless setup by supplying base URL, key, and model arguments directly. Useful in automated scripts and CI pipelines.

```bash
openclaw onboard --non-interactive --accept-risk --skip-health \
  --mode local \
  --auth-choice vllm \
  --custom-base-url "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1" \
  --custom-api-key "vllm-local" \
  --custom-model-id "your-model-id"
```

### Enable persistent home volume for fresh Docker setup (Bash)

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/install/docker.md

Sets the required environment variables to persist container home directories before running setup for a new installation.

```bash
export OPENCLAW_IMAGE="ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:latest"
export OPENCLAW_HOME_VOLUME="openclaw_home"
./scripts/docker/setup.sh
```

--------------------------------

### Update cloud worker setup command for Codex in Bash

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/gateway/cloud-workers.md

Appends the matching Gateway version and Codex plugin installation to an existing cloud worker profile setup command. Uses `--force` so setup replays can converge safely on already-installed plugins.

```bash
gateway_version="$(openclaw --version | awk '{print $2}')"
existing_setup="$(openclaw config get cloudWorkers.profiles.aws.settings.setup)"
openclaw config set cloudWorkers.profiles.aws.settings.setup \
  "${existing_setup}; sudo npm install -g openclaw@${gateway_version}; openclaw plugins install npm:@openclaw/codex@${gateway_version} --pin --force"
```

--------------------------------

### Set Up Linux X11 Session and Live Rig Environment with Bash

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/nodes/computer-use.md

Installs required system dependencies and initializes an isolated Xvfb display session. Prepares the live rig scratch workspace for gateway and node pairing.

```bash
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y at-spi2-core dbus-x11 gir1.2-gtk-3.0 jq openbox python3-gi x11-utils xdotool xvfb

dbus-run-session -- bash
export DISPLAY=:99 XDG_SESSION_TYPE=x11 NO_AT_BRIDGE=0
Xvfb "$DISPLAY" -screen 0 1280x800x24 -nolisten tcp &
openbox >/tmp/openclaw-cu-openbox.log 2>&1 &

scratch="$(mktemp -d /tmp/openclaw-cu-live.XXXXXX)"
scripts/dev/computer-use-macos-live-rig.sh prepare-linux \
  cu-linux-live-proof 29431 "$scratch"
```

--------------------------------

### Headless onboarding and channel setup with environment variables

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/cli/channels.md

Performs non-interactive onboarding and adds a channel using `--use-env` to parse declared environment variables. Ensure the Gateway service receives the same environment variables as the bootstrap shell.

```bash
export OPENAI_API_KEY="<provider-key>"
export TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN="<bot-token>"

openclaw onboard --non-interactive --accept-risk --skip-health \
  --mode local \
  --auth-choice openai-api-key \
  --secret-input-mode ref \
  --skip-channels \
  --no-install-daemon
openclaw channels add --channel telegram --use-env
```

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/skills/gog/SKILL.md

```bash
gog auth credentials /path/to/client_secret.json
```

```bash
gog auth add you@gmail.com --services gmail,calendar,drive,contacts,docs,sheets
```

```bash
gog auth list
```

### Build and run OpenClaw from source

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/help/faq-first-run.md

Clones the repository, installs dependencies with pnpm, builds core and UI assets, and triggers onboarding.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git
cd openclaw
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm ui:build
openclaw onboard
```

--------------------------------

### Run Onboarding for Synthetic API Key via CLI

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/providers/synthetic.md

Launch the onboarding flow targeting the Synthetic API key authentication option.

```bash
openclaw onboard --auth-choice synthetic-api-key
```
